title: Lemon pack
description: Vanilla like modpack to use in our server
body:
![horse and tree ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/HW6PRvYr/images/52d401938bd2bdad66e3b773413606dc9ec61fb7.png)

Lemon Pack is a performance-focused modpack that enhances your vanilla Minecraft experience without changing core gameplay. Designed for multiplayer servers, it combines the best optimization mods with essential quality-of-life features to deliver smooth, enjoyable gameplay for you and your friends.

## What does Lemon Pack include?
### Performance & Optimization
The pack features powerful optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium, ImmediatelyFast to dramatically boost FPS and reduce lag. FerriteCore reduces memory usage, while Concurrent Chunk Management Engine and Very Many Players ensure smooth performance even on busy servers. 

### Enhanced Visuals
Experience beautiful graphics with Iris Shaders support, while Entity Model Features and Entity Texture Features enable OptiFine-style resource packs. 
ClearWaterLava improves fluid rendering, and Bobby allows you to see chunks beyond your server's render distance for stunning views.

### Quality-of-Life Improvements
Navigate easier with Do a Barrel Roll (elytra flight mechanics), Freecam for exploring, and Zoomify for zooming in. UI enhancements include Jade (advanced tooltips), Shulker Box Tooltip, Status Effect Timer, and uku's Armor HUD. Building is made easier with Litematica and Litematica Printer for schematic placement.

### Multiplayer Features
ViaFabricPlus allows connecting to servers running different Minecraft versions, making it perfect for diverse server networks. Locator Lodestones helps you track waypoints across dimensions.
